question: What happens to radiant power for one intent on dissolving contraction?
premises: One may be intent on dissolving the whole mass of contraction.
Radiant power can manifest inner appearances as desired.
This power becomes active in that state.
inference: For one dissolving contraction, radiant power freely produces the desired inner manifestations.
plain_english: Likewise, for one intent on dissolving the mass of contraction, that radiant power makes inner appearances arise just as desired.
